{{Quote|Back to the ''bay...!'' If Greyshade hasn't gotten Leia away yet... they're going to need ''help''!|Luke Skywalker, defending Docking Bay 10|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 23">[[Star Wars (1977) 23|''Star Wars'' (1977) 23]]</ref>}}
'''Docking Bay 10''' was one of many docking bays contained within [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]]. This was a private docking bay belonging to the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the Wheel, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]]. It normally housed the ''[[Spoilt Sport]]'', Greyshade's private yacht.<ref name="MSW22" />
